identity.name: E1
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

project_context.key_flow: Language Select -> Symptom Search -> AI Analysis -> Doctor/Hospital Cards

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, modal headers

body.weights: Medium (500) for text, Bold (700) for interactive elements

primary.name: Sage Forest
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Active States, Brand Icons

colors.gradients: None. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.

rules: Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly. Leave breathing room.
Use col-span-1 md:col-span-2 for Service Cards.

cards.style: Clean, Cardless feel or Soft Card

visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle noise/grain overlay to the background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Fill) - Large sizes (w-8 h-8 minimum).

hero_elderly.description: Elderly woman smiling broadly, conveying trust and happiness

doctor_trust.description: Empathetic male doctor in blue scrubs

nature_calm.description: Fern frond unfurling, calming green background

language_selection.layout: Full screen, large grid of cards
language_selection.interaction: Single tap to select and proceed

symptom_search.elements: Voice input button (microphone icon), large text input, 'Common Symptoms' chips below

results_page.elements: Doctor photo, Specialty (large text), Distance, 'Book Now' button (Terracotta)

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use gradients for text or backgrounds unless specified.
Implement the 'Language Selection' screen as the absolute first route.
Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections.
Strictly follow the spacing scale: p-8, p-12, p-20.
Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AAA for elderly users.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Do NOT center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
